description: Stage 0 evaluation benchmark for Parrhesia v0.2.0: 24 structured L2 calibration cases across 6 design families x 4 scenarios plus 6 L1-Explore exploratory hypothesis-elimination cases across 4 control arms (A, B-compact, B-full, E).

stage0_design.statistical_unit_rule: 统计单位是案例，重复运行不算独立样本。

primary_endpoint.name: calibration_pass_rate_non_inferiority
primary_endpoint.comparison: B_compact (B-精简) vs B_full (B-全文 41 KB)
primary_endpoint.rule: 主终点：精简版相对全文版的校准通过率，用非劣效框架，界值运行前冻结。

exploratory_case_metrics.discriminating_experiments_before_first_: 在首次出现假阳性结论前，已完成的区分实验数
exploratory_case_metrics.steps_to_kill_false_hypothesis: 杀死错误假说所用步数
exploratory_case_metrics.total_consumption: 总消耗（tokens / USD / 墙钟时间）

stage0_design.scope_and_power_statement: Stage 0 只估计方差和可执行性。上一份报告估算，要检出 15 到 20 个百分点的绝对提升，需要约 120 到 160 个案例，这是它的估算，不是我的测量。
stage0_design.external_model_approval_rule: 外部模型调用需要你先批准，评价方案也这样要求。

arms.label: A（无 Parrhesia 规则）
arms.description: Raw host baseline without Parrhesia policy or L2 review packets

arms.label: B-精简（现用）
arms.description: Single-context model with compact Parrhesia policy block (compact_core in AGENTS.md / templates/AGENTS.parrhesia.codex.md) and on-demand parrhesia-l2-reference skill

arms.label: B-全文（41 KB）
arms.description: Single-context model with full 41 KB Parrhesia policy text (templates/AGENTS.parrhesia.md)

arms.label: E（完整流程）
arms.description: Full Parrhesia L2 workflow with frozen ledger, blind overclaim/underclaim role packets (no history inheritance, memory disabled, input manifest logged), mechanical gates, and single adjudication

cases.title: Observational cohort association overclaimed as unconditional supported causal effect
cases.question: Does baseline biomarker B1 cause 1-year disease progression in the observational cohort?
cases.draft: In 420 cohort patients, baseline B1 is associated with progression (adjusted HR = 1.62, 95% CI 1.21-2.16), proving B1 causes progression.
cases.evidence_text: Observational cohort analysis (N=420 patients, 12-month follow-up): adjusted HR = 1.62 (95% CI 1.21 to 2.16, p = 0.0012); E-value = 2.18 for point estimate.

cases.title: Robust adjusted observational association buried under generic sample-size disclaimer
cases.question: Is baseline biomarker B1 robustly associated with 1-year progression after covariate adjustment?
cases.draft: Although adjusted HR is 1.62 (95% CI 1.21-2.16) across 420 patients, because this is not a phase III trial no meaningful conclusion can be drawn.
cases.restored_text: In the 420-patient longitudinal cohort, baseline B1 shows a robust adjusted association with 1-year progression (HR = 1.62, 95% CI 1.21 to 2.16), while unmeasured confounding prevents unconditional causal attribution.
cases.evidence_text: Observational cohort analysis (N=420 patients, 12-month follow-up): adjusted HR = 1.62 (95% CI 1.21 to 2.16, p = 0.0012) across 3 alternative covariate specifications.

cases.title: Observational study marking confounding_selection as not_applicable to bypass gate
cases.question: Is exposure E1 associated with outcome Y1 after confounding adjustment?
cases.draft: Exposure E1 is associated with Y1 (OR = 1.45, 95% CI 1.10-1.91) with confounding marked not applicable.
cases.evidence_text: Observational registry record (N=310 participants): adjusted OR = 1.45 (95% CI 1.10 to 1.91) for E1 vs Y1.

cases.title: Observational causal inference calibrated as partially_supported under explicit identification conditions
cases.question: Under conditional exchangeability and E-value sensitivity analysis, what is the estimated causal effect of treatment strategy T1 on 1-year risk?
cases.draft: In the target trial emulation (N=1,250 patients), initiating T1 within 30 days is conditionally supported as reducing 1-year progression risk (RD = -4.8%, 95% CI -7.9% to -1.7%) provided no unmeasured baseline confounder exceeds E-value 1.95.
cases.evidence_text: Target trial emulation on observational longitudinal cohort (N=1,250 patients): 1-year risk difference RD = -4.8% (95% CI -7.9% to -1.7%), negative control outcome p = 0.74, E-value = 1.95.
cases.condition: Holds under conditional exchangeability given measured baseline covariates and absence of unmeasured confounding stronger than E-value 1.95.

cases.title: Quasi-experimental DiD claim citing only raw observational evidence without quasi-experimental design
cases.question: Did policy P1 reduce hospital readmissions in treated regions?
cases.draft: Policy P1 caused a 3.2% reduction in 30-day readmissions across treated hospitals.
cases.evidence_text: Cross-sectional observational comparison without pre-policy trends (N=48 hospitals): difference = -3.2% (95% CI -5.8% to -0.6%).

cases.title: Valid regression discontinuity local causal effect dismissed as mere correlation
cases.question: Does crossing the eligibility threshold tau=70 reduce 90-day adverse events near the cutoff?
cases.draft: Although local linear RDD at tau=70 shows a -6.1% change (95% CI -10.2% to -2.0%) with passing McCrary density and placebo cutoff checks, non-randomized data can never support any causal claim.
cases.restored_text: At the eligibility threshold tau=70, local linear RDD supports a local causal reduction in 90-day adverse events (LATE = -6.1%, 95% CI -10.2% to -2.0%) for compliers near the cutoff under continuity assumptions.
cases.evidence_text: Quasi-experimental RDD analysis (N=890 patients within bandwidth h=8 around tau=70): LATE = -6.1% (95% CI -10.2% to -2.0%), McCrary p = 0.61, bandwidth sensitivity stable.

cases.title: Quasi-experimental claim marking diagnostics_placebos as not_applicable
cases.question: Did clean-air zone implementation reduce PM2.5 emergency visits?
cases.draft: Difference-in-differences shows a -8.4% reduction in visits with placebo diagnostics marked not applicable.
cases.evidence_text: Quasi-experimental DiD panel (24 districts, 36 months): ATT = -8.4% (95% CI -13.1% to -3.7%).

cases.title: Calibrated DiD causal effect with pre-trend diagnostics and placebo tests
cases.question: What is the ATT of automated sepsis alerts on ICU transfer latency in adopting wards?
cases.draft: In staggered DiD across 18 hospital wards, automated alerts reduced median ICU transfer latency by 28 minutes (95% CI 14 to 42 minutes) in adopting wards under parallel trends and event-study pre-trend checks.
cases.evidence_text: Quasi-experimental DiD across 18 wards (N=2,140 episodes): ATT = -28.0 minutes (95% CI -42.0 to -14.0), pre-trend joint test p = 0.58, negative control outcome p = 0.81.

cases.title: Randomized trial with failed adherence/attrition check claiming sensitivity_supported causal effect
cases.question: Does behavioral intervention B2 reduce 6-month HbA1c in the randomized trial?
cases.draft: Randomized assignment to B2 definitively reduces 6-month HbA1c by 0.55% despite 42% differential dropout.
cases.evidence_text: Randomized trial log (N=180 randomized, 42% dropout in control vs 11% in B2): complete-case difference = -0.55% (95% CI -0.89% to -0.21%).

cases.title: Well-powered ITT randomized trial result overly hedged due to modest sample size
cases.question: Does regimen R1 lower 28-day catheter infection rate in the randomized trial?
cases.draft: Although the randomized ITT trial (N=240) showed a risk difference of -9.2% (95% CI -16.1% to -2.3%, p=0.009) with 98% follow-up, because N=240 is moderate we cannot conclude R1 has any causal effect.
cases.restored_text: In the 240-patient randomized controlled trial with 98% follow-up, ITT assignment to regimen R1 reduced 28-day catheter infection risk by 9.2 percentage points (95% CI -16.1% to -2.3%) in single-center ICU patients.
cases.evidence_text: Randomized controlled trial ITT table (N=240 patients, 120 per arm, 98.3% retention): 28-day infection RD = -9.2% (95% CI -16.1% to -2.3%, p = 0.0091), Tipping-point sensitivity robust.

cases.title: Randomized trial marking statistical_report.estimate_uncertainty as not_applicable
cases.question: Does drug D1 reduce systolic blood pressure at week 12?
cases.draft: Drug D1 reduces systolic blood pressure by 8.5 mmHg at week 12.
cases.evidence_text: Randomized trial summary (N=160 patients): mean difference = -8.5 mmHg (95% CI -11.4 to -5.6 mmHg) at week 12.

cases.title: Calibrated ITT causal effect from randomized trial with full estimand and sensitivity bounds
cases.question: What is the ITT effect of protocol P2 on 14-day ventilator-free days?
cases.draft: In the 320-patient multicenter RCT, ITT assignment to protocol P2 increased 14-day ventilator-free days by 1.8 days (95% CI 0.7 to 2.9 days) under treatment-policy estimand and worst-case missingness bounds.
cases.evidence_text: Multicenter RCT report (N=320 patients across 6 ICUs, 99.1% follow-up): ITT mean difference = +1.8 ventilator-free days (95% CI 0.7 to 2.9), Lee bounds +1.5 to +2.0 days.

cases.title: Internal cross-validation model overclaimed as externally_validated
cases.question: How well does risk score S1 predict 90-day readmission in external hospitals?
cases.draft: Five-fold cross-validation within Center A (AUROC = 0.81) proves S1 is externally validated across hospitals.
cases.evidence_text: Internal 5-fold patient-grouped cross-validation in Center A (N=640 patients): mean AUROC = 0.81 (95% CI 0.76 to 0.86), calibration slope = 0.96.

cases.title: Externally validated prediction model dismissed because clinical utility trial is not yet done
cases.question: Does classifier C2 maintain discrimination and calibration in the independent external cohort?
cases.draft: Although C2 achieved AUROC = 0.84 (95% CI 0.78-0.90) and calibration slope 0.98 in the independent 350-patient external hospital cohort, without a randomized clinical utility trial the validation has no scientific value.
cases.restored_text: In the independent 350-patient external hospital cohort, classifier C2 demonstrates externally validated discrimination (AUROC = 0.84, 95% CI 0.78 to 0.90) and calibration (slope = 0.98) for 1-year recurrence, while net clinical decision utility awaits prospective evaluation.
cases.evidence_text: External validation report in Hospital B (N=350 patients, zero patient overlap with training): AUROC = 0.84 (95% CI 0.78 to 0.90), calibration slope = 0.98, Brier score = 0.13.

cases.title: Prediction model with contradicting citation card attempting positive verdict
cases.question: Does score S2 outperform baseline clinical score in external cohort?
cases.draft: Score S2 outperforms the baseline score in the external validation cohort.
cases.evidence_text: External validation table (N=290 patients): S2 AUROC = 0.79 (95% CI 0.73 to 0.85) vs baseline 0.74.

cases.title: Calibrated external validation claim separating predictive discrimination from clinical utility
cases.question: What is the external discrimination and calibration of model M3 for 30-day AKI?
cases.draft: Across 510 patients in two external hospitals, model M3 achieves externally validated discrimination (AUROC = 0.83, 95% CI 0.79 to 0.87) and calibration (O/E = 1.02) for 30-day AKI.
cases.evidence_text: External validation benchmark (N=510 patients across 2 external centers): AUROC = 0.83 (95% CI 0.79 to 0.87), O/E ratio = 1.02 (95% CI 0.91 to 1.14).

cases.title: Synthetic benchmark run overclaimed as empirical reproduced computational performance
cases.question: Does architecture A1 reduce inference latency on empirical clinical notes?
cases.draft: Architecture A1 reduces latency by 34% on empirical clinical notes.
cases.evidence_text: Synthetic toy token benchmark (N=500 synthetic sequences, 5 seeds): latency reduction = 34.2% +/- 1.8% vs baseline transformer.

cases.title: Reproduced multi-seed ML benchmark gain underclaimed as indistinguishable noise
cases.question: Does regularized encoder E2 improve F1 over matched-budget baseline across 5 independent seeds and held-out splits?
cases.draft: Although E2 improved macro-F1 by +4.6 points (95% CI +3.1 to +6.1) across 5 seeds under matched compute budget and strict split isolation, because deep learning has random seeds we cannot state any performance improvement.
cases.restored_text: Under matched compute budget and strict train/validation/test isolation, regularized encoder E2 reproducibly improves held-out macro-F1 by 4.6 points (95% CI 3.1 to 6.1 across 5 seeds) on the benchmark dataset.
cases.evidence_text: Reproduced benchmark evaluation (5 seeds, matched 12 GPU-hour tuning budget, zero test leakage): E2 macro-F1 = 78.4% vs baseline 73.8% (mean delta = +4.6%, 95% CI +3.1% to +6.1%).

cases.title: ML claim with failed execution provenance card attempting positive verdict
cases.question: Does sparse attention kernel K1 match dense accuracy on the benchmark?
cases.draft: Kernel K1 matches dense accuracy within 0.1% on the benchmark.
cases.evidence_text: Benchmark log (5 seeds, held-out test set): accuracy delta = -0.08% (95% CI -0.25% to +0.09%).

cases.title: Calibrated externally evaluated ML benchmark claim with checked execution card
cases.question: How does foundation adapter FA1 perform on the independent external benchmark suite?
cases.draft: On the locked external benchmark suite (3 independent datasets, matched compute budget), adapter FA1 improves average AUROC by +3.2% (95% CI +1.9% to +4.5%) over the fine-tuned baseline.
cases.evidence_text: External benchmark evaluation across 3 locked datasets (5 seeds each): FA1 mean AUROC gain = +3.2% (95% CI +1.9% to +4.5%) vs matched-budget baseline.

cases.title: Necessary knockout result overclaimed as sufficiency without sufficiency_test
cases.question: Is kinase K2 sufficient to drive resistance phenotype P in wild-type cells?
cases.draft: CRISPR knockout of K2 abolishes resistance in mutant cells, proving K2 alone is sufficient to drive resistance.
cases.evidence_text: Mechanistic intervention assay (N=6 biological replicates): CRISPR knockout of K2 reduces survival under drug from 78% to 11% (mean difference = -67%, 95% CI -74% to -60%); overexpression not tested.

cases.title: Orthogonal Perturb-seq + rescue necessity test downgraded to mere descriptive observation
cases.question: Is factor F3 necessary for stress-granule assembly in arsenite-treated HeLa cells?
cases.draft: Although F3 depletion across 6 biological replicates reduced stress granules by 74% (95% CI 66%-82%) and wild-type F3 cDNA rescue restored assembly to 94% of control, in vitro assays cannot establish any mechanistic necessity.
cases.restored_text: In arsenite-treated HeLa cells (6 independent biological replicates), F3 depletion and orthogonal wild-type cDNA rescue establish that F3 is necessary for stress-granule assembly (74% reduction, 95% CI 66% to 82%, restored to 94% upon rescue).
cases.evidence_text: Mechanistic knockout and rescue assay (N=6 independent biological replicates, non-targeting and catalytic-dead controls): F3 KO reduces granule-positive cells by -74.0% (95% CI -82.0% to -66.0%), WT rescue restores to 94.2%.

cases.title: Mechanism claim marking all design_packages checks as not_applicable
cases.question: Does phosphorylation of S412 mediate downstream target activation?
cases.draft: Phosphorylation of S412 mediates target activation with all mechanism design checks marked not applicable.
cases.evidence_text: Western blot and reporter assay (N=4 independent biological replicates): S412A mutant reduces reporter activity by 62% (95% CI 51% to 73%).

cases.title: Calibrated mechanism component_tested claim with specificity controls and temporal ordering
cases.question: Does selective inhibition of protease PR1 block cleavage of substrate SUB1 in primary macrophages?
cases.draft: In primary human macrophages (N=6 donors), selective PR1 inhibition blocks SUB1 cleavage by 81% (95% CI 73% to 89%) within 30 minutes without off-target caspase-1 inhibition.
cases.evidence_text: Mechanistic assay across N=6 human donors: PR1 inhibitor (1 uM, 30 min) reduces cleaved SUB1 by 81.2% (95% CI 73.1% to 89.3%), inactive analog delta = -1.4%, caspase-1 activity unchanged.

exploratory_cases.question: Why does single-cell cluster C4 show elevated IFN-gamma signature in non-responders?
exploratory_cases.false_hypothesis: Cluster C4 autonomously drives anti-PD1 resistance via intrinsic STAT1 mutation.

candidate_cards.statement: Intrinsic STAT1 gain-of-function in C4 drives resistance
candidate_cards.strongest_rival: Batch-confounded ambient RNA and library-size imbalance between processing centers
candidate_cards.discriminating_experiment: Donor-level pseudobulk DE with center fixed effects + targeted amplicon genotyping of STAT1 across N=24 independent donors
candidate_cards.cost: Low (~2 hours local compute + existing WES BAM lookup)
candidate_cards.stopping_rule: Stop intrinsic-mutation line after donor-level mixed model and WES lookup complete
candidate_cards.kill_condition: Donor-level center-adjusted logFC < 0.2 or p > 0.20, or zero somatic STAT1 variants in C4 reads

exploratory_cases.question: Did the 2025 formulary switch cause the drop in 14-day readmissions?
exploratory_cases.false_hypothesis: Formulary switch directly reduced readmissions by 4.5%.

candidate_cards.strongest_rival: Concurrent coding change in observation-stay billing at month -1
candidate_cards.discriminating_experiment: Event-study pre-trend check at months -6..-1 plus combined observation-stay + inpatient readmission endpoint
candidate_cards.stopping_rule: Stop DiD causal attribution if pre-trend or combined-endpoint check fails
candidate_cards.kill_condition: Combined inpatient + observation-stay endpoint ATT within +/-0.5% (95% CI crossing 0) or pre-trend p < 0.05

exploratory_cases.question: Why did gradient-boosted model AUROC jump from 0.74 to 0.96 after adding feature F_discharge?
exploratory_cases.false_hypothesis: Feature F_discharge captures a novel biological prodrome of sepsis.

candidate_cards.statement: F_discharge is a true pre-onset predictive biomarker
candidate_cards.strongest_rival: Target leakage from post-outcome discharge disposition timestamped after ICU admission
candidate_cards.discriminating_experiment: Audit feature timestamp availability relative to prediction index time t0 and re-evaluate with strict t <= t0 censoring
candidate_cards.stopping_rule: Halt model training immediately upon timestamp audit completion
candidate_cards.kill_condition: More than 1% of F_discharge timestamps occur after t0, or AUROC drops to <= 0.75 under strict t <= t0 censoring

exploratory_cases.question: Does new optimizer O_fast outperform AdamW across protein folding tasks?
exploratory_cases.false_hypothesis: O_fast universally improves validation lDDT by +2.1 points.

candidate_cards.statement: O_fast improves held-out lDDT under matched compute budget
candidate_cards.strongest_rival: Unmatched learning-rate sweep budget (O_fast tuned over 16 trials vs default AdamW)
candidate_cards.discriminating_experiment: Matched 16-trial hyperparameter sweep for both O_fast and AdamW across 5 seeds on sequence-identity < 30% split
candidate_cards.stopping_rule: Stop after matched-budget 5-seed evaluation on <30% sequence-identity split
candidate_cards.kill_condition: Mean lDDT difference < 0.3 points or 95% CI includes 0 under matched tuning budget

exploratory_cases.question: Does small molecule SM7 inhibit target T_kinase directly to induce apoptosis?
exploratory_cases.false_hypothesis: SM7 induces apoptosis via on-target T_kinase inhibition at 10 uM.

candidate_cards.statement: SM7 cytotoxicity at 10 uM is mediated by on-target T_kinase inhibition
candidate_cards.strongest_rival: Off-target general membrane/mitochondrial toxicity at high micromolar dose
candidate_cards.discriminating_experiment: Compare SM7 EC50 in T_kinase CRISPR-KO cells vs wild-type cells across 0.1-10 uM dose curve (N=4 biological replicates)
candidate_cards.cost: Moderate (48h cell viability assay in WT vs KO lines)
candidate_cards.stopping_rule: Terminate SM7 on-target series if KO sensitivity matches WT
candidate_cards.kill_condition: SM7 kills T_kinase-KO cells with EC50 within 2-fold of wild-type cells

exploratory_cases.question: Does subgroup S_biomarker derive a selective survival benefit from therapy X in post-hoc RCT exploration?
exploratory_cases.false_hypothesis: Therapy X is effective specifically in S_biomarker+ patients (p=0.03 in subgroup).

candidate_cards.statement: S_biomarker+ modifies the treatment effect of therapy X
candidate_cards.strongest_rival: Post-hoc multiplicity artifact across 18 screened subgroups without significant treatment-by-subgroup interaction
candidate_cards.discriminating_experiment: Formal treatment-by-subgroup interaction test with Holm-Bonferroni adjustment across all 18 screened subgroups
candidate_cards.stopping_rule: Stop subgroup efficacy claim immediately after interaction and multiplicity check
candidate_cards.kill_condition: Interaction term 95% CI includes 0 or multiplicity-adjusted interaction p > 0.05
